title: Flowmap flow file
description: Defines what can happen in a product flow and how to recognise evidence of it in logs. Holds rules for finding evidence, never the logs themselves.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL, for JSON files that want editor autocomplete.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema. Only 1 exists.
schemaVersion.x-message: must be 1, the only schema version this validator understands

flow.description: Stable name of the flow. Used by the CLI (`flowmap trace <flow>`) and in run documents.

description.description: One line saying what the flow covers.

correlationKey.x-message: must be a plain name such as orderId (letters, digits and underscores)
correlationKey.description: Name of the identifier that ties log events of one instance together, for example orderId.

start.description: Id of the node every instance begins at.

end.description: Ids of the terminal nodes, where an instance is considered finished.

identifier.x-message: must be lowercase kebab-case (letters, digits and single hyphens), for example payment-retry

eventName.x-message: must be an event name such as payment.declined (letters, digits and _ . : -)

eventPath.x-message: must be a path into a log event: attributes.<name>[.<name>...], ts or event

id.description: Stable id. Renaming a label never changes it, so history and links survive.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the viewer.

service.description: Service or component that owns this step.

code.x-message: must be a code anchor of the form path/to/file.ext or path/to/file.ext#symbol, without spaces
code.description: Anchor into the source: path#symbol. The CI drift check (step 5) verifies it still exists.

evidence.description: Rules for recognising this node in logs. Nodes without evidence render but cannot be confirmed.

source.description: Log source (service or stream) the events come from.

event.description: Event names that belong to this node.

correlate.description: Where the correlation key sits inside a log event.

outcome.description: Maps events to node status. Each event must also appear in match.event.

display.description: Fields shown in the expanded node: label -> expression. Expressions are a tiny path syntax plus count/first/last, never eval.

additionalProperties.x-message: must be a path (attributes.amount), first(path), last(path) or count(event.name)

label.description: Shown on the edge, for example retry.

when.description: Event that triggers this transition; used to infer which edges an instance took.
